discussion_question: Which documented coin hoard would you most want to examine?

reel.x: A Morgan dollar bag once yielded stray 1893-S coins mixed among 1894-S dollars. Hoards can rewrite rarity, but an unopened roll is no guarantee.
reel.instagram: Coin hoards can preserve surprises, reshape rarity, or reveal that a once scarce date is more available than collectors thought. This auction photo is marked as a sample from an unarrived hoard.
reel.facebook: What can a wrapped silver dollar roll hide? History offers documented surprises, but no roll promises a rare find. See the story and inspect the auction listing.

youtube.title: When a Silver Dollar Bag Changed Rarity
youtube.description: A documented history of Morgan dollar hoards and hidden discoveries. The auction image is a sample from an unarrived hoard, not proof of the lot contents.
